name: Gaspi's Woodfired Grill
kurzbeschreibung:
**Gaspi’s Woodfired Grill in Tirol**

Discover the smoky, mouthwatering flavors of **Tirol** at **Gaspi’s Woodfired Grill**, where tradition meets fire-roasted perfection. Sink your teeth into succulent grilled meats, crispy **Kaiserschmarrn**, and fresh local sides—all cooked over open flames for that unmistakable char. Whether you're craving a hearty **Tiroler Gröstl** or a juicy steak, this rustic spot in the heart of the Alps delivers an unforgettable taste of the region.

From **Innsbruck** to the countryside, **Gaspi’s** invites you to savor the essence of **Tirol**—one sizzling bite at a time. Come hungry, leave happy.
